         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">'dul ba kun las btus pa</rs> zhes bya ba <rs type="person"><abbr>sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das</abbr></rs> kyis gsung <lb n="193b7"/> pa'i 'dul ba gangs chen mtsho'i snying por gyur pa <abbr>thams cad</abbr> bsdus shing legs par gtan la phab pa'i dka' ba'i gnas rnaM par bshad pa | 
         gang dag bslab pa rin po che la gces par 'dzin pa phrag dog myed cing blo dang ldan pa rnaMs kyi yid dga' bar rgyas par byed pa'i <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4682">ti ka 'thad ldan</rs> zhes bya ba | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3818">shag kya'i dge slong brtson 'grus 'bar</rs> gyis nye bar sbyar ba las |
         kyis <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">bla ma </rs>la grangs mang du mnyan cing nan tan byas nas dgos pa'i gzhung la bltas te gces pa rnaMs kha bskangs te <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4696"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4682">ti ka 'thad ldan</rs> gyi 'grel pa rin chen rgyan 'buM</rs> zhes bya ba nye bar sbyar ba rdzogs s+ho ||||   ||</seg></TEI>
